name: swpc-noaa
description: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC): a CLI for live space-weather data. It reads the NOAA R/S/G scales, the planetary K-index, solar wind and F10.7 summaries, GOES X-ray, proton and electron feeds, alerts, text forecasts and the HAPI time-series API.

commands.name: get-noaa-scales
commands.summary: Current NOAA space weather scales and forecast probabilities: R (radio blackout), S (solar radiation) and G (geomagnetic storm). Key -1 is yesterday, 0 is now, 1-3 are forecast days.

commands.name: get-planetary-k-index
commands.summary: Observed 3-hourly planetary Kp index for the last ~7 days, with running a-index and station count.

commands.name: get-kp-forecast
commands.summary: Planetary K-index observations plus the 3-day forecast (observed, estimated and predicted Kp per 3-hour slot).

commands.name: get-summary
commands.summary: Latest single-value summary: solar wind speed, solar wind magnetic field (Bt/Bz) or the 10.7cm radio flux.

commands.name: get-goes-feed
commands.summary: GOES satellite particle/X-ray time series (flux per energy band) for a satellite slot, instrument and time range.

params.name: instrument
params.description: Feed type, e.g. xrays, integral-protons, integral-electrons, magnetometers (see the /json/goes/primary/ directory listing)

commands.name: list-alerts
commands.summary: Active and recent SWPC space weather alerts, watches and warnings with their full message text.

commands.name: get-text-product
commands.summary: Plain-text SWPC bulletin: 3-day forecast, 27-day outlook or forecast discussion.

params.name: product
params.description: Bulletin name (file name under services.swpc.noaa.gov/text/ without .txt)

commands.name: list-hapi-datasets
commands.summary: Catalog of the roughly 85 HAPI time-series datasets (ACE/DSCOVR/active mag and plasma, Kp, etc.) with ids for get-hapi-info and get-hapi-data.

commands.name: get-hapi-info
commands.summary: Metadata for one HAPI dataset: available parameters, units, cadence and start/stop dates.

params.name: id
params.description: HAPI dataset id from list-hapi-datasets, e.g. kp-pt1h, active-plasma-pt1m, active-mag-pt1m

commands.name: get-hapi-data
commands.summary: Download a HAPI dataset as CSV (time_tag plus the chosen parameters) over a time range: solar wind speed/density, IMF Bt/Bz, Kp/ap, etc.

params.name: id
params.description: HAPI dataset id, e.g. kp-pt1h, active-plasma-pt1m, active-mag-pt1m

params.name: parameters
params.description: Comma-separated parameter names from get-hapi-info, e.g. kp,ap or speed,density,temperature or bt,bz_gsm. Omit for all.

notes: All data is public and needs no login. Most commands hit services.swpc.noaa.gov or the HAPI server at tlv-swpc.woc.noaa.gov, not the www site.
The site has no keyword search, filters or sorting. Pick data by command and path parameters instead.
get-noaa-scales returns an object keyed by day offset. "-1" is the previous day, "0" is current conditions, and "1"-"3" are forecast days with R MinorProb/MajorProb, S Prob and the G scale.
get-goes-feed responses can be large (one row per minute per energy band). Use range 6-hour or 1-day for recent values. Field 'electron_contaminaton' is misspelled as in the source.
get-hapi-data returns CSV text whose first line is the header. Keep time ranges short for 1-minute datasets (pt1m). Fill value is -1e30.
get-kp-forecast, list-alerts and get-text-product use feeds the explorer named in its summary; their exact URLs did not appear in the endpoint list.

News articles (/news-archive?page=N, /news/{slug}) and product pages (/products/{slug}) are server-rendered HTML that redirect (301) to spaceweather.gov. They are not covered because no page structure was recorded.
